title: One-call issuance
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 1. The pipeline at a glance.

statements.label: One-call issuance
statements.requirement: HcertIssuer SHALL take a payload, its codec, a validity and a Signer, and return the HC1 string. On request it SHALL also return the raw COSE bytes, the QR matrix and the EncodingReport.
